LESSON: ANIMAL REARING PROJECT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Animal Production
Topic 2.5: Animal Rearing Project
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Animal Rearing Project, part of Animal Production in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can animal rearing project be carried be out?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Animal Rearing Project together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

● Love: learner develops caring attitude towards others when sharing roles during management of the animal rearing project.

● Social justice: learner fosters fairness and justice by sharing roles equitably when managing the animal rearing project.

● Life skills: learner develops negotiation skills when discussing a budget proposal on animal rearing project with the teacher

and school administration for approval.

● Financial literacy: learner prepares a reasonable budget resource allocation as learners develop project details and budget

for the animal rearing project.
